resolution: Explained + fixed. The idle [DRAGDRAW] frame stall lines were REAL main-thread starvation but not from the user's editing: they fired exactly while the agent ran the slice-1 'rjit game verify' suite twice plus bundle checks on the same machine (the ~185ms ×2/s signature matches the twice-reported no-heavy-builds-during-live-session pattern; the 1500ms one was the dev watcher re-bundling after agent file saves). The watchdog loop ticks even at idle, so external load showed up indistinguishable from drag lag — and drags stayed silent because the drag genuinely is clean now. Fix (caedae7e3, IsoAuthor.tsx): lastInputAtRef marks mouse/key/wheel input on the watchdog's own performance.now clock; a stall with no drag, no pending commit, and no input for 3s is labeled '(idle — external load on this machine, e.g. builds/bundler; not your editing)' and reports at most once per 10s, while interaction-window stalls keep the 1/s cadence (req_0507) untouched.
